details: Developed and adapted backend features and Angular workflows for manufacturing and inventory processes in an enterprise MES.

Built data import, export, and API integration workflows. Added CSV validation, error handling, and transactional rollback to prevent incomplete imports, along with checks to prevent material consumption above available stock.
Investigated production issues, tested fixes, reviewed code, and supported releases with GitLab and Jenkins.
Customized and maintained Sage X3 ERP functionality using Sage X3 4GL and SQL to match client workflows.
Investigated application and database issues, tested changes, and created client-specific Crystal Reports.
Worked with English- and French-speaking clients to clarify requirements and validate solutions.
Built a Node.js prototype using the Sage X3 REST API to retrieve manufacturing order data and display it in a web interface with a weekly calendar.
The prototype was not deployed or adopted in production.
Developed and debugged mobile game functionality using C# and Unity.
Participated in sprint planning, testing, QA, bug tracking, and release delivery.
Served as acting Scrum Master for a small mobile game development team.
Supported sprint planning, task organization, team coordination, and delivery.
